description: HORARIO DE TRÁNSITO UNIDIRECCIONAL VIAL ENTRE LA REPÚBLICA DE CHILE Y LA REPÚBLICA DE ARGENTINA, EN EL COMPLEJO FRONTERIZO LOS LIBERTADORES. is a dataset listed in Chilean national open data portal (datos.gob.cl), an open data portal, published or maintained by Gobernación de Los Andes. Es el Horario de tránsito que se orienta en una única dirección vial entre la República de Chile y la República de Argentina, a través del Complejo Fronterizo Los Libertadores. Coverage: Gobernación de Los Andes. The portal files it under the publisher Gobernación de Los Andes. Its tags are Paso Fronterizo, tránsito. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2015-10-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Non-Commercial (Any). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-cl-portal.
